title: 4BR Pet-Friendly 30A Vacation Home with a Shared Pool
meta_description: Stay at Lemon Drop House, a pet-friendly 4BR, 4BA, 30A vacation home with a shared pool, private beach access, and Seacrest Beach amenities. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: Spacious 4 bedroom / 4 bathroom home in Seacrest near Scenic 30AWelcome to The Lemon Drop House, a thoughtfully designed beach home in Seacrest, Florida, where days are shaped by bike rides along 30A, easy beach mornings, and relaxed evenings shared with family, friends, and your pets. This home provides the space and layout needed for groups to spend time together while still enjoying privacy and comfort.Your SpaceThis 4 bedroom, 4 bathroom home sleeps up to 12 guests and includes a main house plus a private carriage house, making it well suited for multi-family stays and group trips. The three-level layout creates a natural flow between shared gathering spaces and quieter areas to recharge after full days out.Inside, the living area is set up for conversation, movie nights, and downtime after the beach, with a fireplace that’s especially nice during cooler coastal evenings. Both the main house and carriage house kitchens are fully equipped, including a coffee maker, Keurig, blender, and toaster, supporting group cooking and casual meals. The dining area seats eight, positioned next to a breakfast bar with four bar stools, giving everyone a comfortable place to gather for meals and conversation. Two washer and dryer units help keep towels and beachwear in rotation during longer stays.Outdoor SpacesSeveral balconies extend your living space outdoors, offering spots for morning coffee, afternoon breezes, or quiet evenings. Out back, the private gas grill and picnic area make it easy to plan casual outdoor meals after a day at the beach or exploring nearby communities. Garage access and parking for up to three vehicles add everyday convenience.Sleeping Arrangements:* Main House1st Floor – Guest Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV with Jack and Jill bathroom2nd Floor – Primary Bedroom: King bed, TV, balcony access with private bathroom2nd Floor – Guest Bedroom 2: Full bed, TV, balcony access with Jack and Jill bathroom3rd Floor – Loft Area: Daybed with pull-out twin trundle, TV, balcony access with pull-out twin trundle* Carriage HouseBedroom: Queen bed, TV with Jack and Jill bathroomLiving Area: Sofa that pulls out to a queen-size bedBeach AccessEnjoy private beach access just an 8-minute walk or shuttle hop on the seasonal tram, making beach days easy and hassle-free. The tram provides convenient service to the soft white sands and clear Gulf waters of Seacrest Beach.Seacrest BeachDuring your stay, you can take advantage of the Seacrest community’s amenities, including one of the largest lagoon pools on 30A, ideal for swimming and lounging. Explore Peddler’s Pavilion with local shops, restaurants, bike rentals, and open-air events, or enjoy the neighborhood trails and bike paths for walking, running, or cycling. Community picnic areas and open green spaces provide additional spots to relax outdoors.Location & Local ExperiencesStaying at Lemon Drop House places you close to the activities that make the 30A area special. Start mornings with bike rides along nearby paths, spend afternoons at the beach, and plan evenings around local food and entertainment:* Shades Bar & Grill – casual meals and live music* George’s at Alys Beach – coastal cuisine* Rosemary Beach downtown – including The Pearl, Sugar Shack, boutique shops, and outdoor events* 30Avenue – Amigos, Amici’s, Idyll Proper, and Attycat’s Arcade* The Big Chill – beachfront bar and restaurant with a relaxed vibe, perfect for drinks or casual dining* Watersound Town Center – Publix, Village Market, Ambrosia, Nigel’s, and Sweet Henrietta’sEverything from grocery runs to family-friendly outings is within easy reach.Your stay at The Lemon Drop House comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Other Details to Note:* Snowbird Friendly!* Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach community.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 40 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
